messages:
maya (CS): Heads-up — onboarding job for Acme Corp hit repeated embedding failures this morning during their bulk import. Looks like several accounts in the batch didn't finish.
jon (Eng): Thanks for flagging. Seeing errors in the embeddings worker pool: OOM on quantized llama-embedder-4.1 during sequence length spike.
sasha (SE): Is this a model / runtime mismatch or a dataset issue?
jon (Eng): Runtime: kernel selection tried float16 path, fallback to slower path then OOM. Repro with their sample payload.
ops-bot: incident created: I-2026-embeds-batch-176451 — priority P2.
maya (CS): We need a short customer-facing status ASAP. Acme is mid-onboarding and SLA for their pilot expects import within 48h.
leah (CS Manager): Draft a status that is calm + specific. Offer mitigation and timeline. I can approve before send.
sasha (SE): Suggested message: "We're investigating an issue affecting bulk embedding imports for a subset of customers. Our engineers have identified memory pressure in the embedding runtime and are working on a fix. We'll provide updates every 60 minutes and will proactively complete your remaining imports or provide a manual export." Thoughts?
maya (CS): Good. Add: "No customer data has been lost; imports will be resumed or a manual workaround offered."
jon (Eng): Mitigation plan: 1) roll back to previous kernel selection forcing conservative kernel (takes ~10m), 2) re-run failed batch with throttling, 3) deploy memory guard to avoid OOM bursts. ETA for rollback and re-run: ~30–45m.
sasha (SE): Command for rollback (internal):
```
kubectl -n inference set env deployment/embeds-runtime KERNEL_POLICY=conservative && kubectl rollout restart deployment/embeds-runtime
```
jon (Eng): We'll coordinate the restart during a low-traffic window to avoid broader impact.
maya (CS): OK I'll share a tailored note to Acme: short status, ETA 45m, offer manual assist to get them into the pilot.
leah (CS Manager): Add a note that we'll credit their pilot pool for any delay >24h.
maya (CS): Draft outbound to customer queued. Posting here for review before I send — please keep edits minimal.
sasha (SE): Quick edit: change "memory pressure" to "runtime memory limit exceeded" — slightly clearer for non-eng.
maya (CS): Updated draft below.
---
maya (CS): Hi @Acme team,
We're investigating an issue affecting bulk onboarding imports. Our engineers have identified that the embedding runtime exceeded memory limits for unusually long inputs, which caused some imports to fail. We are: 1) applying a conservative runtime kernel (started), 2) re-running the failed imports with throttling, and 3) offering a manual import if you prefer.
Estimated time to resume and complete your imports: ~45 minutes. No customer data has been lost. We will provide another update in 60 minutes or sooner if resolved. If you'd like immediate help, please reply and we can arrange a manual import.
Thank you for your patience — Maya, Redwood Customer Success
---
leah (CS Manager): Looks good. Send and paste the sent copy here.
maya (CS): Sent at 1764512335. Copy pasted below and flagged account in CRM.
maya (CS): "Sent: Hi Acme team — we're investigating an issue affecting your bulk onboarding import... (same message)"
jon (Eng): Rollback applied and runtime restarted at 1764512350. Monitoring logs now.
sasha (SE): Re-run queued with 50% throttling. First batch success.
ops-bot: incident update: I-2026-embeds-batch-176451 status -> investigating -> mitigation in progress.
maya (CS): Great. I'll follow up with Acme at +30m with progress and next steps.
leah (CS Manager): Make a note to capture feedback after onboarding completes and log any renewal risk flag if pilot timeline slips beyond agreed window.
maya (CS): Will do. Closing loop here later with final notes and any credits applied.
jon (Eng): RCA snapshot for internal postmortem: root cause = aggressive kernel selection for long sequences + insufficient guard for quantized path; short-term mitigation = conservative kernel policy + throttled re-run; long-term action = add auto-detection for sequence spikes and circuit-breaker to prevent OOM.
sasha (SE): I'll help draft the technical appendix if customers ask for more details.
maya (CS): Thanks team. I'll update the ticket and CRM and post final status once imports complete."
